---
name: Mod idea
about: Propose a new mod or a parameter to document
title: "[Idea] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What would it do?**

Describe the mod or guide addition you have in mind and the use case.

**Is this a new mod or a guide addition?**

- [ ] New mod
- [ ] Parameter(s) to document in the modding guide

**Which units/parameters are involved?**

List the units, buildings, or parameters involved, with their IDs if you know them (see [docs/UNIT_IDS.md](../../docs/UNIT_IDS.md)). For example: unit 195 (spy), tech 25 (spy nuke), `unitType[155].attack.weapon`.

**Willingness to help**

- [ ] I'd like to help code it
- [ ] I can test it
- [ ] Idea only — up to the community

**Additional context**

Anything else that might help (screenshots, links, similar mods in other games, etc.).
